name: VOXLAP RLE Voxel Storage
definition: In-memory compressed voxel storage using RLE format, organized as a 2D array of columns with batched edit support.
summary: VOXLAP RLE Voxel Storage is a fixed-size, column-major in-memory structure for CPU volume rendering that uses run-length encoded slabs to efficiently store and edit large 3D voxel grids.
